name: Kibi-chūō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kibi-chūō town emblem in light blue, blue and red: a light blue stylised swirl with a blue stroke and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kibi-chūō, a town in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Kibi-chūō town emblem — a light blue stylised swirl with a blue stroke and a red disc
